resolution.note:
Both refuters killed every blocking finding, so the row stamps PASS:verify-refuted and this REVISE stays as the record. pedagogy §52d line 88: harm: The facts check out, but the finding is wrong to call this BLOCKING, and it cites the wrong rule.

Facts I confirmed:
- `node scripts/validate-backing.js curriculum/exercises/read-your-stack.md` exits 1 with ANCHOR-DRIFT at L88.
- Commit 218bab12 (Antti, 2026-09-03) changed L35 from "A recurring kind of work has a shape. Steps in order, a branch, a loop back. Drawn, the shape is easier to recognise than described." to "A recurring kind of work has a shape: steps in order, a branch, a loop back."
- The file has no uncommitted changes.

Why it does not survive as BLOCKING:

(1) Wrong rule. The mechanical clause of §52d covers swapping the file's **The point:** line and re-quoting the claim that quotes it. The point line (L13) was not what changed here. A body bullet was, and on purpose: the commit message says the bullet "no longer closes on the file's own The-point line". The finding treats a deliberate cut of a duplicated sentence as a skipped §52d step.

(2) Nobody is worse off (harm lens a/b). The `<!-- backing -->` block is maintainer-only ledger text. No student reads it and it is never projected. The harm claimed ("the block asserts a provenance link to text the file doesn't say") just restates the validator rule. It names no consequence for anyone in the room.

(3) Another line already carries the meaning (lens d). The dropped clause "Drawn, the shape is easier to recognise than described" duplicated the point line, "draw the recurring work so you see the forest before the trees". The claim's idea still sits in the body. Only the quoted anchor string is stale.

(4) No gate enforces this. validate-backing.js is referenced only by package.json `audit:backing` and its own test. It is not in npm test or the board gates, which recent commits report green at 25/25. The corpus-wide run shows 10 ANCHOR-DRIFT errors across 7 files: spot-gaps-build-the-loop, access-is-not-absorption ×3, grounded, practice-of-risk ×2, when-to-split-an-agent, where-is-this-all-going. That is a known background state of the maintainer ledger, not a defect that blocks this exercise.

(5) The fix is right and cheap, but it is a maintainer-block tidy-up with no card, not a blocker. Re-anchor the claim to "A recurring kind of work has a shape: steps in order, a branch, a loop back." It should be a TODO or non-blocking note.
